text.offer: The swarms keep coming back, and now I know why: queens. Great bloated things that breed them up in the cliff hive. Kill three of the queens and the swarms will thin for good.
text.progress: The dragonfly queens nest in the cliff hive, and one has been seen outside the mad scientist's hut.
text.complete: No more queens, no more swarms. You've done Ko'catan a great service - and my business.
